head: SERIF
dzh: 焦橙芥末黄墨绿、粗衬线、颗粒感
den: Burnt orange, mustard and teal, fat serif, grain
nzh: 焦橙、芥末黄、墨绿三色，配粗衬线大标题；彩虹条纹、圆形徽章做装饰；底色叠一层很淡的颗粒噪点；图片调成褪色暖调
nen: Burnt orange, mustard and teal with fat serif headlines; rainbow stripes and round badges as decoration; a very light grain over the background; faded warm photos
